prompt: The script solution.sh reads lines from stdin and prints each one trimmed of surrounding whitespace, delegating the trimming to the normalize() function in lib.sh. But trailing whitespace isn't being removed — only leading whitespace is. Track down the root cause and fix it so normalize() strips both leading AND trailing whitespace, while leaving whitespace in the middle of a line untouched. Run it like: printf '  hi  \n' | bash solution.sh
